scope: User-authorized scoped guide commit/push preparation and global working-tree link deployment

commit_scope.included: GUIDE-01 procedures, owner/template integration, installer recovery, behavior runner/evidence, approved media QA and README
commit_scope.excluded: Preexisting product-detail-page-builder/manifest integration, camera catalog/implementation feature, unrelated QA, .from-backup files, cache/temp files and line-ending-only changes
commit_scope.note: Historical 25-skill behavior/installation records came from the working checkout. The scoped index removes unrelated additions and was separately tested; no claim of fresh model execution on the index.

isolated_index_regression.skip_reason: Real delivery fixtures in community-shorts-stills-pipeline require both ffmpeg and ffprobe; ffprobe is unavailable.
isolated_index_regression.initial_failure_and_repair: One test unnecessarily pinned the dirty checkout to 25 skills; replaced with required existing-owner membership, unique IDs and no guide-specific new skill. The test now also passes the committed 24-skill baseline.
isolated_index_regression.limits: Final README/report-only updates are outside the recorded index tree; no source behavior was changed after these runs.

deployment.mode: symlinks to current working tree, not an immutable committed release
deployment.preserved: Existing unrelated installed skills and local unfinished source changes; source support regenerated only from existing reserved derived payloads.
deployment.active_session: Files and discovery paths updated. The running session's skill menu/system prompt cannot be hot-reloaded through these tools; run /reload or start a new session.

git_publication: Commit and remote SHA verification are performed after this pre-commit validation record; this file does not predict their success.
